```plato

//==
// # TRS transforms
//
// Translate-rotate-scale transforms in 2D and 3D: the authoring-friendly
// representation whose three parts are edited independently. They are NOT closed
// under composition — rotating a non-uniform scale leaves the TRS family — so
// compose them through their matrix or affine forms
//. The operations live in
// `transforms.library.plato`.

// A translate-rotate-scale transform in 2D, applied scale first, then rotation,
// then translation.
type TrsTransform2D
    implements IValue, IAffine2D
{
    Translation: Vector2D;
    Rotation: Rotation2D;
    Scale: Number2;
}

// A translate-rotate-scale transform in 3D, applied scale first, then rotation,
// then translation.
type TrsTransform3D
    implements IValue, IAffine3D
{
    Translation: Vector3D;
    Rotation: Quaternion;
    Scale: Number3;
}

//==
// # Elementary transforms
//
// The single-purpose building blocks — the atoms — of the transform surface: one
// named operation each, in the plane and in space. Every one of them converts to
// the general affine transform of its dimension, and that affine form is how they
// compose: the elementary families are NOT closed under composition (two
// translations compose to a translation, but a rotation and a scaling do not stay
// in either family). The `*About*` types apply their operation about `Center`
// rather than about the origin. The operations live in
// `transforms.library.plato`.

// A translation in the plane: every point is displaced by the same vector
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Translation_(geometry)).
type Translation2D
    implements IValue, IRigid2D
{
    Vector: Vector2D;
}

// A translation in space: every point is displaced by the same vector
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Translation_(geometry)).
type Translation3D
    implements IValue, IRigid3D
{
    Vector: Vector3D;
}

// An axis-aligned scaling about the origin in the plane, with an independent
// factor per axis (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scaling_(geometry)).
type Scaling2D
    implements IValue, IAffine2D
{
    Amount: Number2;
}

// An axis-aligned scaling about the origin in space, with an independent factor
// per axis (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scaling_(geometry)).
type Scaling3D
    implements IValue, IAffine3D
{
    Amount: Number3;
}

// A uniform scaling about the origin in the plane: the same factor on every axis,
// so angles are preserved (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homothety).
type UniformScaling2D
    implements IValue, IAffine2D
{
    Amount: Number;
}

// A uniform scaling about the origin in space: the same factor on every axis, so
// angles are preserved (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homothety).
type UniformScaling3D
    implements IValue, IAffine3D
{
    Amount: Number;
}

// A mirror across a line in the plane, given as a point on the line and the
// direction along it (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reflection_(mathematics)).
type Reflection2D
    implements IValue, IAffine2D
{
    Origin: Point2D;
    Direction: Direction2D;
}

// A mirror across a plane in space, given as a point on the plane and its unit
// normal (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reflection_(mathematics)).
type Reflection3D
    implements IValue, IAffine3D
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    Normal: Direction3D;
}

// A rotation in the plane about an arbitrary center rather than the origin
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_(mathematics)).
type RotationAbout2D
    implements IValue, IRigid2D
{
    Rotation: Rotation2D;
    Center: Point2D;
}

// A rotation in space about an arbitrary center rather than the origin; the
// rotation axis passes through Center
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_(mathematics)).
type RotationAbout3D
    implements IValue, IRigid3D
{
    Rotation: Quaternion;
    Center: Point3D;
}

// An axis-aligned scaling in the plane about an arbitrary center rather than the
// origin; Center is the one fixed point
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scaling_(geometry)).
type ScalingAbout2D
    implements IValue, IAffine2D
{
    Amount: Number2;
    Center: Point2D;
}

// An axis-aligned scaling in space about an arbitrary center rather than the
// origin; Center is the one fixed point
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scaling_(geometry)).
type ScalingAbout3D
    implements IValue, IAffine3D
{
    Amount: Number3;
    Center: Point3D;
}
```
